why: In the keep-the-work-up items, watching-and-repairing and fighting-an-attack keep sliding into each other because most repair is provoked by attackers and most defence is done by re-placing pixels.

why.T3-004: The concepts work out the mark's look and details - three-pixel letters, two-pixel whitespace, the red dot on the i, correcting coordinates - so settling the design leads rather than a template merely posted for placers.

why.T3-010: Negotiating shared space with neighbours leads - coexist peacefully, create a border our flag will not cross, make deals with surrounding art - and the material also satisfies T3-006, T3-011, T3-084, T3-150, T3-194 and T3-149 at the floor, so this item is a bag.

why.T3-001: Members stage their own fakes as true - the million-pass VIA claim and the Confederation Bridge seen from Mount Carleton - and others play along, extend, or reveal them, which is the room's own April Fools fake rather than testing someone else's claim.

why.T3-070: The group posts and re-posts its current template and a direct link to its territory so placers can reproduce the work - directions shared for use, not one design imposed against rival versions.

why.T3-010: The room works out where neighbouring marks fit around the MIT logo - reciprocal-help offers, an agreement with r/farmcarrots, suggesting a region, and McGill resizing its birb so as not to overwrite - which is settling space and lines with neighbours where no fight is being fought.

why.T3-009: The plurality of concepts mark the room's own finished work as achieved - woke up to a perfect flag, we did it, marked our place in Internet history, still holding strong, finished really well - so celebrating the completed flag leads, with crediting and post-close reporting as later variations.

why.T3-031: The concepts play the room's own running jokes in canvas talk - the its/it's and Eh? exchanges, the maple leaf as Pokemon or Space Invaders, the 158 and Confederation-1859 gags - which is the sub's in-jokes, not staged fakes or taunts at rivals.

why.T3-015: The room concentrates r/place talk - asking for a sticky, posting updates into one thread, removing posts with a pointer to the gathering place - which is routing canvas posts into one place; the item also satisfies T3-063, T3-090 and T3-185 at the floor, so it is a bag.

why.T3-021: The bulk of the concepts keep the work intact by hand - fixing changed pixels, maintaining ground, checking back and repairing - which is watching and repairing.
why.T3-005: A distinct set calls the room to fight attackers under way (vandals attacking, need backup; under attack, need help), which watching-and-repairing does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: watching and repairing carries upkeep but not the alarm-and-fight calls made when attackers are actively erasing the flag
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: calls to fight back under attack, e.g. vandals attacking need backup and under attack need help, satisfy T3-005
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-005 - dropping it would lose the active-defence reading and leave only upkeep

why.T3-041: After the logo is done the room proposes and tries a further piece, Tim the Beaver, beside its existing mark - adding to the work already up rather than proposing a first mark, and the falling-back is not made the point here.

why.T3-005: The passages call people to defend the small logo against vandalism and give coordinates plus a javascript to keep it, an answer aimed at attackers, which is defending the work rather than keeping watch with no attacker in view.

why.T3-180: The concepts contest who belongs to the nation and who may act for it - why does Quebec get its own flag if we are all Canadian, being Canadian does not mean one language, whether Quebec's flag is Canada's to overwrite - and the item also satisfies T3-130, T3-061, T3-006, T3-113 and T3-010 at the floor, so it is a bag.

why.T3-004: Same material as position 1: the concepts work out the mark's look and details - letter thickness, whitespace, the red dot on the i, correcting coordinates - so settling the design leads rather than a template merely posted for placers.

why.T3-009: The lone concept marks the room's finished logo as good - Nice work! - which is the work recognised as achieved, not encouragement while it is still going on nor credit to named makers.
